queries:
WITH order_invoice_counts AS (
    SELECT o.order_id, COUNT(i.invoice_number) AS invoice_count
    FROM Orders AS o
    LEFT JOIN Invoices AS i ON i.order_id = o.order_id
    GROUP BY o.order_id
),
invoice_shares AS (
    SELECT
        invoice_count,
        1.0 * invoice_count / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Invoices) AS invoice_share
    FROM order_invoice_counts
),
average_share AS (
    SELECT AVG(invoice_share) AS value
    FROM invoice_shares
)
SELECT
    SUM(s.invoice_count) AS combined_invoice_count,
    AVG(s.invoice_share) AS average_share,
    AVG(s.invoice_share - a.value) AS average_excess
FROM invoice_shares AS s
CROSS JOIN average_share AS a
WHERE s.invoice_share > a.value

WITH invoice_counts AS (
    SELECT o.order_id, COUNT(i.invoice_number) AS invoice_count
    FROM Orders AS o
    LEFT JOIN Invoices AS i ON i.order_id = o.order_id
    GROUP BY o.order_id
),
shares AS (
    SELECT invoice_count,
           1.0 * invoice_count / NULLIF(SUM(invoice_count) OVER (), 0) AS share
    FROM invoice_counts
),
average_share AS (
    SELECT AVG(share) AS value
    FROM shares
)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(s.invoice_count), 0) AS combined_invoice_count,
       a.value AS average_share,
       AVG(s.share - a.value) AS average_excess
FROM average_share AS a
LEFT JOIN shares AS s ON s.share > a.value

    SELECT order_id, COUNT(*) AS invoice_count
    FROM Invoices
    GROUP BY order_id
),
shares AS (
    SELECT invoice_count,
           1.0 * invoice_count / SUM(invoice_count) OVER () AS invoice_share
    FROM invoice_counts
),
average_share AS (
    SELECT AVG(invoice_share) AS average_share
    FROM shares
)
SELECT SUM(s.invoice_count) AS combined_invoice_count,
       a.average_share,
       AVG(s.invoice_share - a.average_share) AS average_excess
FROM shares AS s
CROSS JOIN average_share AS a
WHERE s.invoice_share > a.average_share
